registration_endpoint.description: URL of the [client registration endpoint](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7591#section-3). Present when Dynamic Client Registration is available.

jwks_uri.description: URL of the [JWK Set](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517#section-5) holding the keys of the authorization server.

response_types_supported.description: Response types the authorization endpoint supports.

grant_types_supported.description: Grant types the token endpoint supports.

token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported.description: Client authentication methods the token endpoint supports.

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_values_s.description: JWS signing algorithms the token endpoint accepts for [`private_key_jwt`](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7523#section-2.2) client assertions.

revocation_endpoint_auth_methods_support.description: Client authentication methods the revocation endpoint supports.

revocation_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_val.description: JWS signing algorithms the revocation endpoint accepts for `private_key_jwt` client assertions.

introspection_endpoint_auth_methods_supp.description: Client authentication methods the introspection endpoint supports.

introspection_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_.description: JWS signing algorithms the introspection endpoint accepts for `private_key_jwt` client assertions.

code_challenge_methods_supported.description: [PKCE](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7636#section-4.2) code challenge methods the authorization endpoint supports.

client_id_metadata_document_supported.description: Whether the authorization server accepts [Client ID Metadata Documents](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document), an HTTPS URL used as the `client_id`.

authorization_response_iss_parameter_sup.description: Whether authorization responses carry the [`iss` parameter](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9207#section-2) identifying this authorization server. Compare it to `issuer` before using the `code`.
